ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/yellow) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan diatom film covering the lower-medial section of both lobes.
